scope: Re_tau180 channel validation goal and fair timing comparison; no OpenFOAM speedup claim

metric_definitions.stress: RMS error divided by peak absolute reference value, separately for uu,vv,ww,uv
metric_definitions.mean_stationarity: max absolute difference between equal averaging-half means divided by full-window mean
metric_definitions.stress_stationarity: RMS difference between averaging-half stress profiles divided by full-window u_tau^2 and reference stress peak

lbm_engineering_requirements.integer_mass_and_momentum_ledgers: exact, including wall impulse and forcing
lbm_engineering_requirements.repeated_states: bit identical for gated numerical tests
lbm_engineering_requirements.population_precision: 40fractionbits fine;43coarse mass-storage bits; collision precision gate40vs44<=1e-5 velocity

performance_objective: minimize wall-clock time and resource cost for an accepted result; no speed credit for failed physics

openfoam_comparison.required: same3D problem, physical averaging interval, comparable turbulence treatment, same observables/error limits and declared hardware/resource budget; report setup and solver time separately
openfoam_comparison.sampling_requirement: Use a common physical wall-distance evaluation grid before a cross-solver ranking. Current refined reporter uses native planes for log/stress/parity and interpolated fine planes for whole-mean L2; preserve historical gate receipts and do not equate differing quadratures.
openfoam_comparison.lbm_only_requirements: Integer-ledger and bit-repetition checks are implementation checks, not a requirement to use identical arithmetic in another solver.
